summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist in monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (stdlib os/json only), exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added the "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with autofunction in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist and the four specified tests. Nothing was committed and no tests, black, or flake8 were run. Line lengths were checked by measurement: none exceed 120 characters, but black formatting is unverified. Design choices: a non-object top-level JSON and a non-list value under the key both raise ValueError; path checks run only when the field is present.
